text:
ria: FYI saw a sudden cluster of resume retries right after the console change that tightened the route-stability window. Affected tenants saw multiple resume attempts within <2s and downstream billing spikes.

tomas: Ugh. Any logs?

ria: Snip from edge-proxy:
```
2026-06-11T14:02:01Z INFO resume_initiated session=s-201 token=tokZ route=eu1
2026-06-11T14:02:02Z INFO route_stability_changed session=s-201 old=eu1 new=eu-fast flag=priority_tight
2026-06-11T14:02:02Z INFO resume_initiated session=s-201 token=tokZ route=eu-fast
```
So the console flip caused a route reassign mid-resume and we got two resume events back-to-back. Runtime ACK for first never arrived before the second.

harper: Our billing pipeline treats the first resume_initiated as the bill signal. We definitely need to stop that.

ops: Quick mitigations proposed: 1) server-side debounce: ignore identical session+token resume within 1500ms, 2) add billing guard to require runtime ack before emit.

tomas: I'll own the debounce PR. Small change in session manager: if resume arrives and last_resume_ts for session+token < 1500ms, reply with 200 but don't emit billing. Add unit test.

harper: I'll open BILL-420 to gate billing on resume_ack and add integration test to confirm no charge without ack.

insights-bot: Alert rule created: resume_retries_per_session > 3 in 2m -> page eng-oncall.

ria: Telemetry pain: route and feature_flag tags were missing from resume metrics because the metric-proxy dropped unknown labels during rollout. We couldn't slice by canary vs prod.

harper: I'll hotpatch the shim to pass through new labels and add a dashboard panel for resume_ack latency by route.

ops: Short term plan: deploy debounce to staging in 5m, patch metric shim, then if retries persist rollback console toggle for canary.

tomas: Deployed debounce to staging. Will monitor for 15m then promote.

ria: Postmortem action items: console rollout checklist must include a route-stability guard and metric tag validation; billing signals must be authoritative (runtime ack); add console warning when window < 500ms.

harper: Also notify CS for tenants with anomalous billing and offer remediation credits where applicable.

ops: TL;DR: debounce + billing guard + metric tag fix + console UX guard.
